title.es: Sulfuro de níquel con lamas de serpentina

description.en: Pentlandite in a serpentinised ultramafic host; soft serpentine grinds to slimes that entrain into the froth and carry MgO, the penalty element for the smelter.
description.es: Pentlandita en una roca ultramáfica serpentinizada; la serpentina blanda se muele a lamas que se arrastran a la espuma y aportan MgO, el elemento penalizado por la fundición.

question.en: How do slimes set the grade-recovery compromise?
question.es: ¿Cómo fijan las lamas el compromiso ley-recuperación?

provenance: authored scenario; parameters inside cited ranges; not plant-calibrated

sources.breakage: Moly-Cop Tools energy-specific selection (alpha0 0.0091 t/kWh, alpha1 0.651, alpha2 2.5, d_crit 6514 µm) and its documented alternative breakage set (beta0 0.4, beta1 0.65, beta2 4.02); dossier section 1.4.
sources.crusher: Whiten classification K1 0.5 to 0.95 CSS, K2 1.7 to 3.5 CSS, K3 about 2.3; dossier section 1.3.
sources.cyclone: Plitt geometry ratios typical of mineral-processing cyclones; sharpness and underflow density authored; dossier section 2.
sources.flotation: k from bubble surface area flux (Gorain et al. 1997), Savassi entrainment, perfect-mixer banks; floatability and widths authored within Trahar (1981) size behaviour; dossier section 3.
sources.collector: Saturating collector response with gangue saturating at higher dose (chalcopyrite/pyrite critical review, PMC9572913); dossier section 3.5.
sources.water: Process-water capacity per tonne of ore (pumping and thickener capacity), authored 5% above each case's nominal requirement; it is the water constraint of the operating-point optimizer.
sources.kpi: Each nominal KPI range carries its own source in kpi_sources: a published value or range where one was found, labelled authored where none was; they are plausibility gates, not predictions.

recovery_pct.en: Authored: no published range was found for this case type.
recovery_pct.es: De autor: no se encontró un rango publicado para este tipo de caso.

concentrate_grade.en: About 20% Ni in serpentinised Mt Keith-type ore (review, Minerals 14(10):965, 2024, doi:10.3390/min14100965); the two-point band is authored.
concentrate_grade.es: Cerca de 20% Ni en mena serpentinizada tipo Mt Keith (revisión, Minerals 14(10):965, 2024, doi:10.3390/min14100965); la banda de dos puntos es de autor.

concentrate_MgO.en: About 10% MgO at a concentrate Fe:MgO of 2.9 at Mt Keith (Senior et al. 2006, Int. J. Miner. Process.; from the search-index summary, UNVERIFIED against the full text); the band is authored.
concentrate_MgO.es: Cerca de 10% MgO con una razón Fe:MgO del concentrado de 2,9 en Mt Keith (Senior et al. 2006, Int. J. Miner. Process.; según el resumen del índice de búsqueda, NO VERIFICADO contra el texto completo); la banda es de autor.
